notes.content:
📢 Battle Titan RAINBOW – 8.Development Update

Hello everyone, this is Pola. with another Bi-monthly Dev-Log.
As the game grows in scale, new challenges have appeared, but progress continues steadily.

[previewyoutube="nJg6s0ZnWtA;full"][/previewyoutube]

🏁 Final Stage Design Begins
Structured in 3 parts: Stratosphere Re-entry → Fortress Assault → Interior Battle

About 15 minutes of playtime, roughly double a normal stage

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/77ba1cdfe974ce52ffba0ba6e3234dc77f924e8d.jpg"]


🌵 Stage 5 Desert STAGE - Improvements
Added sandstorms, lighting effects, and atmosphere enhancements

Visual upgrades without disrupting game play



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/3eba74fc1984f489a48b38b151555a83f28ece94.jpg"]  


🎥 VFX & Camera Enhancements
Zoom blur, motion blur, and UI alpha blending

Retro shooter feel with modern cinematic effects



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/c45e8143f6cc2b71abe21f98a44538689bd2a1b4.jpg"]


🤖 Mecha - Artwork
Main robot design finalized

Unique mechanical art and high-quality sprite production underway



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/9f86f81bdbbf0ba7d2580e45a3871b49a30f1bf7.jpg"]


💥 Boss Bullet Patterns
Arcade Mode: Cave-style bullet-hell

Journey Mode: Retro shmup-style patterns



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/ab1d04fa0e5c9dfce2232f9535996cae1f7ddb3e.jpg"]


⚡ Combat Speed Improvements
Faster and expanded lock-on mechanics

Awakening Mode redesigned into a Mazinger Z-style booster combination



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/a82f1e011d560007197299323e7c04b70eac5ecd.jpg"]




🛡️ Additional Playable Units

notes.title: Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev 1. 2025. 4. 4 Week
notes.content:
Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev.
We’d like to share the changes made to the game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/10ae6db530a2ef337d88d59d3425b06eba0d95e4.jpg
Game Genre
Previously, the game had RPG-like mechanics with levels, stats, gear, and various options, only the combat was STG-based. This required extensive development in balance, graphics, and design.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/2f42ac3227dffcf0d40cb20175513580af60dd19.jpg
Now, the game is purely a Shm-up [STG], where each player selects characters with unique weapons and traits. We've streamlined choices to help players quickly enter gameplay and focus on combat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/697ebef3c4d3ba53ea79730e6bb54efff1fb5add.jpg
Battle Stage
There are 7 themed stages with 3 game modes:
ARCADE: Quick gameplay with short battles.
JOURNEY: Long gameplay based on 7 episodes.
MATCH: 1 vs 1 Boss battles.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/f5080924134c7d4ddb4d6b0975f5033aae8ae5f0.jpg
Boss Type
Bosses range from bullet-hell to fighting-game styles. JOURNEY has the highest difficulty and multiple phases. You can CONTINUE after Game Over in JOURNEY mode.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/51bb129569321c35cc170098367105a1179a5b1a.jpg
Story
Previously set over a year-long road-movie style narrative, now it focuses on a "7-day event" air operation.


"The protagonist is the heir of a martial arts sect defeated by enemy forces. Driven by personal vengeance and to restore honor, they fight alongside allies using the cursed mech (RAINBOW), awakened from its seal."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/e40a1f7cb8e1faa25cc980b830fd1a0f0768292a.jpg

 Detailed lore can be accessed via the Gallery menu. 
 It blends SF martial arts with classic super robot anime tropes,
  featuring a mix of super and real robot designs.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/23f1284561bbdf995038a3fe0c287b5957fcd77c.jpg
Boss Concept:  Battle Titan - Silver Wind

notes.title: Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev. [2025-1Q]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/f469e28e1177ab91fc732022c240b3aa1485fb4d.jpg
Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev. [1Q-2025]

Hello,
 I am the developer of Battle Titan RAINBOW.
It has been 1,151 days since the first demo was uploaded. During this time, 
I was unable to update the Steam page with new information about the game. 
Due to various challenges, progress was delayed, but development has continued, and I am now able to share an update.

[olist]
 The game is still in development. 
 As a solo developer working part-time while managing other responsibilities, 
     progress has been steady. 
 The genre has shifted from RPG to SHM-UP, focusing on a more streamlined 
     development process to bring an early access version as soon as possible.
 A new demo, different from the currently uploaded version,
    is planned for release between May and June.
 Localization efforts are underway, but as I am not a native speaker, 
     some translations may contain errors. I appreciate your understanding.
 I will continue to share development updates at intervals of one week to one month.
    You can find the latest development progress at the link below.
[/olist]
